text: The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
(Published by Authority) PART III — LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය
අති විෙශෂ
No. 1892/45 – FRIDAY, DECEMBER 12, 2014
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
Land Min. No.: LD/05/2003/WS/630.

I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose.

Description of the land to be acquired: Three (03) lots of Land Extent of 0.4034 Hectare shown in Serial map No. Aa/NCDW/2003/704p Dated on 25.12.2013 prepared by the Survey Superintendant, situated in village of Thuruvilla in Nuwaragam Korele Miner Division in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Nachchaduwa in Anuradhapura District of North Central Province described as follows.
01. Lot No. “Q” — Name of the Land: Thuruwila Garden; Owner’s Name and address: Awusadha-gamige Chandrathilaka, Thuruwila, Hodogama; Extent: 0.0655 Hectare.
Description: North: “A” Chandrathilaka’s Land; East: “A” Chandrathilaka’s Land and Lot No. “R”; South: Lot No. “R” and “N”; West: Lot No. “N” and “P”.
02. Lot No. “R” — Name of the Land: Thuruwila Garden; Owner’s Name and address: Awusadha-gamige Gunathlilaka, Thuruwila, Hodogama; Extent: 0.0875 Hectare.
Description: North: Lot No. “Q” and A. Gunathilaka’s Land; East: A. Gunathilaka’s Land; South: Lot No. “N”; West: Lot No. “N” and “Q”.
03. Lot No. “Ay” — Name of the Land: Thuruwila Garden; Owner’s Name and address: M. Senarathna, Thuruwila, Hodogama; Extent: 0.2504 Hectare.
Description: North: Lot No. “AU”; East: Lot No. “AZ”; South: Thuruwila Wewa; West: Thuruwila Wewa Lot No. “AW” and “AZ”.

All persons interested in the aforesaid lands on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Nachchaduwa Divisional Secretariat on the 05th January, 2015 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 05th January, 2015 the nature of their interest in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
J. W. S. KITHSIRI, Divisional Secretary, Nachchaduwa. Srawasthipura.
Divisional Secretariat, Nachchaduwa, 01st December, 2014. 12 - 984
